# `core/schema/SchemaValidator.js`

> **Source:** `engine/core/schema/SchemaValidator.js`

SchemaValidator — Validates game data against JSON schemas. Lightweight validator (no external deps). Checks required fields, types, enums, min/max, and array items. Reports all errors.
